suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Friday and let me actually enjoy the weekend.
I'm thankful for the smell of teh tarik being poured right as I walk into the mamak, half dead from the day.
I'm grateful for catching a null pointer in code review before it ever touched prod.
I'm thankful for the quiet ten minutes before Fajr when the whole street is still asleep and it's just me and my thoughts.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually pushed back on an unrealistic deadline on my behalf.
I'm thankful for nasi lemak wrapped in banana leaf tasting better than it has any right to on a Monday.
I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that failed fast instead of wasting my whole afternoon.
I'm thankful for my mother still texting 'sudah makan?' even though I'm thirty minutes away, not three states.
I'm grateful for rain hitting the roof right as I'm closing my laptop for the day.
I'm thankful for a stable paycheck landing on time this month, no drama, just rezeki doing its thing quietly.
I'm grateful for an old teammate reaching out just to check in, no work agenda attached.
I'm thankful for finding a parking spot right outside the surau with two minutes to spare before Isyak.
I'm grateful for a bug that turned out to be a typo and not three days of debugging.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's curry still tasting exactly the way it did when I was a kid.
I'm grateful for a Sunday with absolutely nothing on the calendar, not even a meeting invite lurking.
